overview: TGIIC (Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation) is a Telangana Government initiative established in 2014 for providing infrastructure through development of industrial areas, including identifying and developing potential growth centers with developed plots/sheds, roads, drainage, water, power, and other infrastructural facilities, as well as social infrastructure like housing for workers near industrial zones. It also coordinates with agencies for communication, transport, and other facilities, and has active projects in Public-Private Partnership Mode. TGIIC develops Industrial Parks in all districts of Telangana and develops industrial clusters based on demand and product availability, availing Government of India grants under MSE-CDP scheme for newly developing clusters and upgradation of existing Industrial Parks.
objectives: Identify and develop potential growth centers in Telangana
Provide developed plots/sheds, roads, drainage, water, power and other infrastructural facilities
Provide social infrastructure like housing for workers near industrial zones
Coordinate with agencies for communication, transport and other facilities
Develop Industrial Parks in all districts of Telangana
Develop industrial clusters based on demand and availability of products
Avail Government of India grant under MSE-CDP scheme for newly developing clusters and upgradation of existing Industrial Parks
eligibility: The individual will have to submit downloaded application form which was already filled in on-line duly signed by Applicant / the authorized person together with valid documents in original at the Head office/Zonal Office for land allotment.
benefits: Access to developed industrial plots/sheds with infrastructure including roads, drainage, water, power, and other facilities; social infrastructure like housing for workers near industrial zones; coordination for communication, transport and other facilities; opportunities in Public-Private Partnership Mode; presence in each Mandal Head Quarters of the District; industrial areas ranging from 15 acres to 2500 acres.
financial_support: TGIIC avails Government of India grant under MSE-CDP scheme for the newly developing clusters and up gradation of existing Industrial Parks.
application_process: 1. Submit downloaded application form which was already filled in on-line duly signed by Applicant / the authorized person 2. Together with valid documents in original at the Head office/Zonal Office 3. The Sub-committee formed with members from TGIIC, TSPCB, SFC, Commissioner of Industries, APITCO, technical consultants will scrutinize the DPR & related documents and recommend the extent of land for allotment 4. Considering these recommendations, the State Level Allotment Committee formed with the same members will approve/defer/reject the application 5. The applicant will receive the decision of the committee on the same day through his/her registered mobile.
required_documents: Downloaded application form filled in on-line
